items.title: AI Scientist - Domain Expert Crashworthiness
items.location_text: Paris, Amsterdam, Linz, Munich, London, Berlin
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. ABOUT THE JOB Mistral AI is looking for a Domain Expert in crashworthiness simulations to help build AI-accelerated simulation capabilities for industrial engineering. You will work at the intersection of industrial simulation, physics modeling, machine learning, and engineering workflows. Your role is to bring deep solid-mechanics expertise into the design, training, evaluation, and deployment of AI Physics Models for real engineering use cases. This is a hands-on technical role. We are looking for someone who understands industrial structural simulation not only conceptually, but through direct experience with simulation models, solver workflows, data generation, validation, and engineering decision-making. You will work with research, product, and customer-facing teams to ensure that our models are useful against real engineering standards — not only benchmark metrics. Relevant application areas may include automotive crashworthiness, aerospace structures, consumer-electronics drop/reliability, manufacturing, durability/fatigue, and other nonlinear structural mechanics problems. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Work with our research team to define, generate, and iteratively improve simulation datasets for training and evaluating crashworthiness foundation models, balancing coverage of relevant physical scenarios, simulation fidelity, and computational cost. - Design and run high-fidelity simulation campaigns using structural mechanics solvers such as Abaqus, LS-DYNA, Ansys Mechanical, Radioss or equivalent tools. - Define the relevant variation space for training data: geometry, mesh resolution, material behavior, boundary conditions, loading, contact, joints, failure modes, and engineering KPIs. - Build or guide automated pipelines for simulation setup, execution, post-processing, dataset creation, and model evaluation. - Work with research teams to train and evaluate AI models on simulation data, and diagnose failure modes caused by data gaps, poor coverage, numerical artifacts, or model limitations. - Evaluate model outputs against industrial engineering needs, including field-level accuracy, scalar KPIs, deformation modes, load paths, energy absorption, stress/strain fields, failure indicators, uncertainty, and out-of-domain behavior. - Work with industrial customers to understand their simulation workflows and engineering priorities, define use cases and success criteria, and incorporate their feedback into model development and validation. ABOUT YOU - You have deep expertise in crashworthiness, solid mechanics, and structural mechanics, with substantial experience in industrial simulation workflows. - You have a Master’s degree or equivalent technical depth in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, civil/structural engineering, computational mechanics, applied physics, or a related field. - You have 4+ years of relevant industrial experience (or PhD +1 years) in domains such as automotive, aerospace, and consumer electronics. - You have hands-on experience with explicit dynamics for crash or impact simulation and understand nonlinear FEM and related topics such as contact, plasticity, structural dynamics, buckling, material modeling, fracture/damage, fatigue, crashworthiness, or durability. - You have direct experience with simulation validation, correlation, model quality, numerical sensitivity, and engineering KPI definition. - You are a strong Python developer who can build and maintain reliable tools for simulation automation, data processing, and model evaluation. You apply sound software engineering practices, including version control with Git, automated testing, code review, and clear documentation. - You have hands-on experience working in Linux and HPC environments, including submitting and monitoring batch jobs, selecting appropriate compute resources, and troubleshooting simulation workflows. You can run simulation campaigns efficiently across a compute cluster. - You are comfortable operating in ambiguous technical environments and turning poorly defined industrial problems into scoped datasets, experiments, metrics, and execution plans. - You communicate clearly with both deep technical experts and non-specialist stakeholders. IT WOULD BE GREAT IF YOU - Have experience applying machine learning, surrogate modeling, reduced-order modeling, optimization, or data-driven methods to simulation problems. - Have contributed to reusable internal tools, open-source code, simulation automation frameworks, or production-quality engineering workflows. - Have experience working directly with industrial customers, product teams, or engineering decision-makers. - Have publications, patents, internal technical leadership, or recognized contributions in engineering, simulation, computational mechanics, or ML-for-physics communities. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Customer Support Specialist ll
items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . JOB DESCRIPTION As a Customer Service Agent II, you’ll join a high performing team of passionate support professionals who know their performance is critical to Coinbase achieving its mission. You will dedicate your time to assisting customers and teammates with inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring a positive experience for our customers. You will serve as a bridge between the customers and the company, offering empathetic, knowledgeable, and efficient support. What you’ll be doing (ie. job duties): Responsible for providing support for Coinbase customers across multiple channels (phone, messaging & email) by investigating, troubleshooting and resolving customer issues. Use all available resources to ensure high standards are met and work is carried out in the most efficient manner. Be a trusted advisor, listen and empathize so the customer knows they are valued. Ensure their voices are heard through accurate issue tracking and upstream solutions. Take ownership and use critical thinking to find the root cause and solve the customer issue on the first contact. Where this is not possible, ensure all defects are logged appropriately. Seek opportunities to add value for customers through education, proactivity and clear expectation setting. Set a high bar for Customer Service Agents within the organization by setting an example through performance and work ethic. What we look for in you (i.e. job requirements): Motivated by Coinbase’s mission and creating a flawless support experience for our global customer base. Shift and weekend work is a requirement. Minimum of 2-3 years of relevant experience in customer support and/or financial services, crypto, technology. Experience with different channels of support, including voice, messaging, and email. Phenomenal communication skills in order to operate globally across multiple departments and stakeholders. Flexible and adaptable to meeting the evolving needs of a high-growth and fast paced organization. Must be able to read, write and speak in English. Experience at crypto exchanges or in financial services, ideally in payments, trading operations or technical support. Willing to work from an office at Manila, Philippines Nice to haves: Understanding of Google apps, JIRA, Salesforce Service Cloud, or Amazon Connect. Experience working with and partnering with external business partners. Requirements: Demonstrates the ability to responsibly use generative AI tools and copilots (e.g., LibreChat, Gemini, Glean) in daily workflows, continuously learn as tools evolve, and apply human‑in‑the‑loop practices to deliver business‑ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in efficiency, cost, and quality. #P78863 Pay Transparency Notice: The target annual base salary for this position can range as detailed below. Total compensation may also include bonus eligibility and benefits (including medical, dental, and vision). Annual base salary range (excluding bonus): ₱364.61 — ₱383.80 PHP Application Limit: Candidates may submit a maximum of 3 applications within a 6-month period. Equal Opportunity Employer: Coinbase is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information. Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. US Applicants: View Employee Rights , Know Your Rights , and E-Verify Notice of Participation. Accommodations: If you are an individual with a disability who needs a reasonable accommodation, email us your request and contact info at accommodations[at]coinbase.com. Need screen reading technology? Click here to download a free compatible screen reader and view the tutorial . items.title: Trust Strategy & Operations
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE As part of the trust team, you'll collaborate across functions to design and implement systems that streamline trust workflows, enhance decision-making around risk, and support responsible growth. The team operates as strategic advisors to key cross-functional partners — including Product, Operations, Legal, Marketing, and Engineering — to drive accountability, insights, and operational integrity across the business. items.title: Customer Success Manager, Beneficial Deployments EMEA
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Join Anthropic as an EMEA-based Customer Success Manager supporting our Beneficial Deployments team's work with nonprofits. You'll be a strategic partner and trusted advisor to mission-driven organizations across EMEA, spanning a range of impact areas. Your focus is driving activation, adoption, and value of Claude across Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, and the API. That means helping these organizations evolve how they work internally, and guiding them as they evolve how they serve their missions and constituents with AI. You'll work as a pod with your Account Executive and Applied AI counterpart. Within the pod, you'll decide what level of engagement each customer most needs and either personally deliver it or connect the customer to resources that serve their needs. CS-led engagements range from high-touch 1:1 partnerships to one-to-many cohort engagements, with the latitude to design other approaches where they serve customers better. As one of our early Customer Success Managers in EMEA, you'll be a pioneer: helping to build regional processes, establish new customer relationships, and represent Anthropic's brand in a high-growth market. You'll operate with significant autonomy while staying closely aligned with global teams, which calls for someone who thrives in ambiguous environments and works effectively across time zones. The insights you gather from these partnerships will directly inform our research priorities, product development, and strategies for beneficial AI deployment. As the voice of the customer, you'll help shape how we build and deliver AI systems that amplify social good. Key responsibilities Work as a pod with your Account Executive and Applied AI counterpart, building shared territory and success plans Drive activation and adoption across your portfolio, using your judgment to match the engagement model to what each customer most needs Use your knowledge of each customer and of regional nuances to plan usage proactively, understanding current and future consumption and adoption and how they create realized value for the customer Build trusting relationships with nonprofit leaders, program teams, and IT staff to understand their mission, goals, and capacity Guide customers in evolving how they work internally, with change management suited to mission-driven cultures, including Train the Trainer programs, Center of Excellence development, and enablement that respects capacity constraints Help customers evolve how they serve their missions and constituents with AI, identifying high-impact use cases across program delivery, research, fundraising, and operations Become an expert in Anthropic's products across the API, Claude for Enterprise, and Claude Code, guiding customers to the right solutions and keeping them current on what's new Document and quantify value realized through social impact outcomes, program effectiveness, cost savings, and mission amplification, and share it in regular impact reviews that build the case for continued investment Build the repeatable playbooks, enablement resources, and regional processes that scale across the EMEA portfolio, and bring customer insights back to Product and Research You may be a good fit if you have 5+ years of experience in customer-facing roles (Customer Success, Consulting, Solutions Architecture, or similar), ideally supporting mission-driven organizations such as nonprofits, foundations, educational institutions, or government agencies Experience working as part of an account team alongside sales and technical counterparts Experience managing high-touch strategic accounts and designing one-to-many programs (cohorts, webinars, user communities, or similar), with the judgment to know which a customer needs A track record of driving activation and adoption of new technology, including change management in organizations with limited technical capacity Experience driving success across both consumption-based and seat-based business models Technical fluency with AI/ML concepts, API integrations, and software implementation patterns, and the ability to explain them to audiences from frontline staff to executive leadership A strategic mindset to identify opportunities for expanded social impact and turn them into actionable plans Comfort operating with significant autonomy in an early-stage regional team, and working effectively with global colleagues across time zones Passion for both AI and social impact work, with strong interest in ensuring frontier AI systems are developed safely, ethically, and deployed to benefit society A knack for bringing order to chaos and an enthusiastic "roll up your sleeves" mentality (Bonus) Fluency in French, German, Spanish, or Italian The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: £125,000 — £165,000 GBP Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.description: Are you ready to get the Easygo Edge? We’re looking for a Social & Marketing Coordinator to turn internet culture into measurable growth at Easygo - a crew surpassing 1,500 globally, powering Stake and KICK, two of the world’s largest online entertainment and livestreaming platforms. You’ll spot what’s about to break through across streaming, crypto and social, then run the partner relationships and social PR that turn it into results. It’s hands-on, fast-moving work, often from idea to shipped in the same day. What you’ll build with us: You’ll keep our clipping ecosystem sharp, from the CPM-based clipping and UGC creator networks to the trackers, payout files and creator lists that keep them running. You’ll also pitch and place content with large social pages and press outlets, and coordinate campaign moments around signings, collaborations and brand partnerships. You’ll work with creators, pages, outlets and internal teams, reporting to the Partnerships Manager in Marketing. We know that innovation ignites when we build and create together, in person. This is a full-time opportunity at our Melbourne office. You’ll work right where it all happens, surrounded by our fearless crew shipping high-impact work. Who is Easygo? We’re a high-growth, high-velocity tech company with millions of eyeballs on us every day. We’re building the future of fearless tech. We’re the creators behind some of the most popular brands including Stake, KICK and Easygo Games. While they command a fierce global following, our crew is employed directly by Easygo and that’s where the real fun happens. We’re always looking for people who are hungry, humble and move fast. People who are ready to Unify , Disrupt and Evolve with us. With us you’ll grow faster and go further. Your work has impact. And that gives you an edge you can’t get anywhere else. The impact you’ll make: Spot and act on trends across Kick, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, X, TikTok, Discord and crypto and streaming communities, and turn those observations into campaign ideas quickly. Run social PR by pitching and placing content with large social pages and press outlets, and coordinate campaign moments around signings, collaborations and brand partnerships. Oversee our CPM-based clipping and UGC creator networks, monitoring spend and performance and keeping tracking sheets and payout data accurate. Own the operational details, including payout files, creator lists, campaign trackers and approval statuses, so work moves forward without gaps. Take ambiguous requests from idea to shipped outcome, coordinating creators, pages, outlets and internal teams. Your track record: A genuine interest in streaming, crypto and internet culture, with a strong sense of what audiences will notice and share. Strong marketing instincts and the ability to explain why an idea will land with a specific audience. High attention to detail and confidence owning spreadsheets, trackers, reporting and data hygiene alongside creative campaigns. Familiarity with Excel or Google Sheets and basic campaign tracking and reporting tools. The ability to manage multiple relationships across creators, social pages, media outlets and internal teams at the same time. A proactive, self-directed approach with a bias toward action, and the confidence to turn ambiguous requests into clear next steps and completed work. Organisation and dependability when several fast-moving priorities compete for attention. Commercial awareness and an audience focus, balancing creative judgement with performance data. Clear, confident communication with external partners and internal stakeholders. Bonus points if you also have: Experience with Discord communities, clipping or UGC networks, or CPM-based creator programs. Experience in streaming, gaming, crypto, betting or an adjacent industry. Benefits that give you the Easygo Edge, so you can build the future of fearless tech with us: Disrupt: we push boundaries and play to win Ballots for major sporting and music events Time with our partners and ambassadors, and exclusive office sessions with leading streamers, creators and industry guests Spin the Wheel Fridays on your birthday and work anniversary, with prizes up to $1,000 or a car EV subscriptions, novated leasing, energy savings through Origin, and everyday discounts and cash back through Paylab Rewards Evolve: we’re in constant motion, personally and professionally The ultimate sandbox: 1 in 3 of our people level up their role every year. If you deliver, you move. Market-synced pay, a performance-based bonus and a high-value referral bonus 30 days combined annual and personal leave for full-time employees 18 weeks paid parental leave for primary carers and 2 weeks for secondary carers, plus a 12-week return to work with fully paid Fridays off Employee Assistance Program for you and your family, and 7% off Bupa health cover with extras waiting periods waived Wednesday massages, a meditation space, parenting facilities, and bike storage, lockers and showers for active commuters Unify: we move as one and win together Daily catered breakfast, free barista coffee, juices and smoothies, and snack walls and drink fridges on every floor Pool tables, table tennis, gaming consoles, an F1 simulator, social sports teams and the Corporate Games Mid-year and end-of-year celebrations, team budgets for wins and milestones, and a paid volunteer day each year Benefits apply to Australian-based employees, are subject to eligibility and program terms, and may change. We play fair. We hire fair. True to our value of ‘Play fair’ we always hire fair. Our work and our brands are fuelled by our diverse culture. We hire for talent and grit. But we never discriminate. Your race, religion, nationality, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status won’t affect our hiring decision, or your trajectory here. Come as you are and get the Easygo edge.

items.title: Research Program Manager, Safety Measurement
items.description: About the Team Safety Systems manages the complete lifecycle of safety efforts for OpenAI’s frontier models, ensuring our models are deployed responsibly and have a positive impact on society. Our work spans diverse research and engineering initiatives—from system-level safeguards and model training to evaluation and red-teaming—all aimed at mitigating misuse and maintaining our high bar for safety. We lead OpenAI's commitment to developing and deploying safe Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), fostering a culture of trust, responsibility, and transparency. Our goal is to continuously learn from deployments, distribute AI’s benefits widely, and ensure that powerful tools remain aligned with human values and safety considerations. About the Role The Safety Measurement Research Program Manager drives OpenAI’s strategy for safety measurement and evaluations, partnering closely with safety research, data science, and engineering to advance how we measure harm and safeguard efficacy across research and production. You will work directly with researchers, data scientists, policy owners, and product teams who contribute to or use our measurement systems, identifying the most important problems to solve and shaping the data, dashboards, tools, and workflows we build for them. This role combines measurement expertise, product judgment, and cross-functional execution: you will engage with evaluation results and data workflows, make prioritization tradeoffs, and drive work from problem definition through rollout and iteration. This position is based in San Francisco, CA, with relocation assistance available. In this role, you will: - Define strategic priorities and product roadmaps to improve safety measurement and evaluation approaches and scale our measurement platform to new use cases, products, and the needs of cross-functional teams - Partner closely with research, data science, engineering, policy teams, and other stakeholders to craft a vision for understanding safety outcomes and prevalence across our products, and translate that vision into concrete programs of work. - Drive the integration of cutting-edge AI safety research into OpenAI’s safety measurement and evaluation platforms, working with researchers, data scientists, and engineers to navigate technical tradeoffs, coordinate dependencies, and resolve blockers. - Develop and continuously refine clear, actionable success criteria that effectively capture our ambitions with safety measurement and evals. - Represent quantitative progress on safety to senior leadership. items.title: Senior Product Designer - Sports F/M
items.description: 📍 Hybrid work model: Our Product Design team is based in Bordeaux, but we hire across Europe. Minimum 4 days per month in our Bordeaux office. WE ARE BETCLIC 🎯 Betclic, European leader in sports betting, is much more than just an online gaming site! Also offering Poker, Horse Racing, and Casino games across various countries and continents, it is an inspiring and forward-thinking company: every day brings new challenges in a modern and dynamic environment. As an influential player in the tech industry, with strong and sustained growth over the years, we believe in innovation through diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone to reach their full potential. With our multicultural team, we provide an optimal, safe and responsible gaming experience, powered by cutting-edge technology. WHY JOIN US? 🚀 At Betclic, success comes from passionate and committed teams. Here's why you'll love working with us: 💡 An international and creative environment where every project is an opportunity to innovate 📈 Hypergrowth that brings new challenges and development opportunities every day 🏡 A healthy work-life balance: flexible remote work and workplace well-being are essential pillars for us 🌟 A unique and friendly atmosphere, with 1,600 employees across 5 countries and our headquarters in Bordeaux Are you passionate about sports and tech? Join us and help shape the future of online gaming! ENTER THE GAME 🎮 As a Senior Product Designer , you will join Betclic's Product Design team, working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, User Researchers and Content Designers to help millions of players discover relevant sports, events and betting opportunities. Betclic is mobile-first, operating in a fast-moving, real-time entertainment environment. You will transform complex sports betting journeys into intuitive, personalized and engaging experiences that make discovering sports, events and betting opportunities intuitive, relevant and engaging. Beyond improving existing features, you will help shape the future of trusted sports entertainment through strong UX fundamentals, player psychology, thoughtful interaction design and Responsible Motivation. YOUR ROLE WITHIN BETCLIC 🔥 In this role, your main missions will be: 🏟️ SPORTS PRODUCT SQUAD The squad helps players discover relevant sports, competitions and betting opportunities across Betclic's extensive catalogue. Key challenges include: Discovery and navigation : making large amounts of sports content easy to explore and understand. Personalization : translating recommendations and player preferences into relevant, trustworthy experiences. Real-time complexity : designing clear interactions for live events, changing odds and complex betting markets. Evidence-driven improvement : using player insights and product data to identify opportunities and improve experiences. WHAT YOU WILL DO 🚀 In your squad, you will: Lead complex design challenges end to end , from framing player problems and exploring alternatives to validating solutions, preparing implementation-ready designs and learning from results. Design intuitive and engaging mobile-first experiences that simplify complex sports content, navigation, personalization and real-time betting journeys. Make informed design decisions , using player insights, product data and critical thinking to challenge assumptions, evaluate trade-offs and balance player value, business goals, technical constraints and regulatory requirements. Explore and validate meaningful alternatives , using workshops, research, experimentation and interactive prototypes to test important assumptions before committing to a solution. Apply strong UX/UI and emotional design craft to create clear, accessible and engaging experiences that encourage participation responsibly – without misleading players or compromising their understanding and control. Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, User Research and other CXP disciplines , contributing throughout Discovery, Delivery and post-launch learning. Use AI-assisted design tools responsibly to accelerate exploration, prototyping, iteration and validation while maintaining human judgment and quality standards. Raise design quality beyond your own work , providing constructive feedback, mentoring less-experienced designers and contributing to shared UX patterns and Design System improvements. Measure and improve experience outcomes , working with Product, Data and User Research to define success criteria, evaluate results and turn learning into future improvements. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE Your impact goes beyond delivering high-quality designs. You help the team make better product decisions, simplify complex player journeys and create engaging, trustworthy experiences that improve player outcomes. You independently lead complex initiatives, contribute to shared design standards and help other designers grow. Your success is reflected in improved player experiences, better-informed product decisions, stronger design quality and the positive influence you have on other designers and shared design practices. HOW WE THINK ABOUT AI 🤖 AI is becoming a core part of modern Product Design. At Betclic, we use AI-assisted workflows to accelerate research support, ideation, prototyping, iteration and validation while keeping human judgment, creativity and accountability at the center. You don't need to master every AI tool, but we expect curiosity, practical experimentation and the ability to critically evaluate AI-generated work, including its limitations and risks. WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? 🔍 We are looking for passionate and curious professionals who bring kindness and a touch of enthusiasm! This job is for you if: You have substantial experience designing complex digital consumer products , with demonstrated impact and the ability to independently lead design work from discovery through delivery. You have strong UX/UI fundamentals , including information architecture, user journeys, interaction design, usability, accessibility, and mobile-first design. You enjoy solving complex product challenges , such as personalization, large content catalogues, real-time information, and sophisticated user journeys. You demonstrate professional judgment , using evidence, critical thinking, and clear reasoning to challenge assumptions, explain decisions and balance competing requirements. You are comfortable exploring alternatives, prototyping and validating ideas before converging on a solution. You collaborate effectively with Product Managers, Engineers, User Researchers, and other designers , and can constructively influence decisions. You have high standards for design quality and enjoy mentoring others, sharing knowledge and improving reusable design patterns. You have a genuine interest in sports and digital entertainment . Previous betting experience is valuable but not essential. You are curious about AI-assisted design and willing to experiment with new tools and ways of working. You can work professionally in English; French is a plus. WHAT ARE THE RECRUITMENT STEPS? 📝 If your application is shortlisted, our recruiter will contact you within a week for an initial HR screening (30 minutes). Then, you will complete the AssessFirst test (personality, motivation and cognitive reasoning). About two weeks later, you will either take a technical test with one of our design experts or work on a case study to present to the team. Next, you will meet your future manager, followed by a member of the Executive or Management Committee. Finally, the recruiter will conduct a final HR interview to review your AssessFirst results together. The recruitment process usually takes between 4 to 6 weeks to ensure an optimal experience for you. WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT? 🎁 ✅ 25 days of paid leave and 10 RTT days 🍽️ A Ticket Restaurant® card credited with €11 per day (€6 per day funded by Betclic) 🩺 100% health insurance coverage for you and your children 🚆 50% reimbursement of public transport costs or an annual sustainable mobility allowance (€230 for commuting with sustainable transport) 🏡 Hybrid work model 📚 Access to a vast training catalog, with opportunities for professional development every year 🏢 Extraordinary office spaces with a rooftop where you can enjoy sunny breaks with a view of the Cité du Vin 🎉 Internal events to liven up your daily life 🏋️ On-site sports classes and organized tournaments (Pilates, circuit training, boxing, yoga, futsal, padel, tennis…) Permanent contract, available immediately in Bordeaux, remote work possible from another city (on-site presence required 4 days a month) 📍 Betclic Group – 117 Quai de Bacalan, 33300 BORDEAUX

items.title: Research Scientist, Life Sciences (Large Molecules, Process Development)
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic's Life Sciences team is building a research group focused on biological discoveries by combining AI with hands-on biological research. We're seeking a research scientist with deep expertise in antibody process development and manufacturing to join the team. Our goal is to speed up progress in the life sciences by an order of magnitude, and this role puts that mission into practice. You'll be an expert in making antibodies, with hands-on experience expressing, purifying, characterizing, and formulating them, from small screening batches to material for IND-enabling studies. Above all, you'll close the loop between AI-generated hypotheses and experimental data to share with the community. Working alongside AI researchers and engineers, you'll build and run the workflows that turn AI-designed sequences into well-characterized protein, and pressure-test AI predictions of expression, stability, and manufacturability against real data. This role is fully on-site in the San Francisco Bay Area. Key responsibilities Develop and run expression and purification processes for antibodies and other recombinant proteins end to end, including transient and stable expression in mammalian cells (HEK293, CHO), affinity capture (Protein A, IMAC), polishing chromatography, buffer exchange, and formulation Characterize what we make with the right analytical panel, for example SEC, CE-SDS, icIEF, LC-MS (intact mass, peptide mapping, glycans), DLS, thermal stability, endotoxin, and binding kinetics (SPR, BLI) Build the laboratory for this work, including selecting, installing, and qualifying equipment and setting up workflows that scale from plate-based production of hundreds of designs to gram quantities of a lead Evaluate AI-designed antibodies for manufacturability (titer, aggregation, stability under stress, viscosity, chemical liabilities), drive them to experimental readout, and feed results back to research teams Plan the chemistry, manufacturing, and controls (CMC) path toward IND-enabling studies, from cell line development and scale-up to analytical methods and stability, and coordinate technology transfer and manufacturing with external contract manufacturers Ensure experimental data across programs is high quality and well documented, including batch records, methods, raw data, and failure modes Communicate findings clearly to biology, AI research, and life sciences audiences Minimum qualifications PhD in biochemical engineering, chemical engineering, biochemistry, or a related field Demonstrated experience in process development and manufacturing of antibodies or other recombinant proteins, including material supplied for IND-enabling or clinical studies, with recent, sustained hands-on laboratory work Comfort navigating ambiguity and defining problems in a rapidly evolving research environment Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across cross-functional teams, with strong written and verbal communication skills Preferred qualifications 5+ years of biologics process development experience beyond the PhD Depth in both upstream (cell line development, bioreactors) and downstream (chromatography, filtration) development, with working knowledge of analytical and formulation development Experience setting up a protein production or process development laboratory, including laboratory automation and high-throughput, plate-based expression and purification Experience directing technology transfer and GMP manufacturing at contract development and manufacturing organizations, with contributions to the CMC sections of an IND Statistics or coding skills, for example design of experiments or Python for data analysis and automation Experience using AI or ML tools in the life sciences Publications and/or patents demonstrating scientific impact The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $300,000 — $320,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . Senior Software Engineer, (Coinbase One) We’re hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join the Coinbase One product team within the Consumer Product Group. Coinbase One is Coinbase’s membership product, offering a suite of benefits for a recurring subscription fee to help customers get more from Coinbase. You’ll own customer-facing experiences and the frontend capabilities behind them, making it easier for customers to sign up, discover relevant benefits, and use their membership. What you’ll do Own frontend development for Coinbase One experiences in the Coinbase retail application, including sign-up flows, subscription payment experiences, targeted benefits, and special promotions and incentives. Build reusable frontend components and platform capabilities that enable the team to launch and maintain membership features. Lead projects from technical design through implementation, testing, and launch, breaking complex work into milestones and communicating risks and tradeoffs. Partner with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to translate customer needs into reliable, intuitive user experiences. Improve frontend performance, reliability, and maintainability through automated testing, production debugging, and ongoing improvements informed by customer and product feedback. Mentor engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, and documentation, helping the team deliver high-quality software consistently. Required skills and experience Experience designing, building, and shipping production frontend applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, and React. Experience integrating GraphQL APIs and writing automated unit tests for customer-facing features. A track record of independently delivering complex software projects, making technical tradeoffs, and maintaining software after launch. Experience building reusable components and improving application performance, reliability, and code quality. Ability to collaborate across engineering, product, and design, clearly communicate technical decisions, and mentor other engineers. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. We are hiring for this role on a full-time contract basis to provide paternity leave coverage through the end of June 2027. Cohere is in a unique and exciting position to grow our go-to-market teams globally! We are hiring for this role on a full-time contract basis to provide paternity leave coverage through the end of June 2027. items.title: Senior Engineer, Bioinformatics
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As a Senior Software Engineer on the Life Sciences team, you'll build biology software that our own scientists and the wider research community can depend on, and you'll be one of the main people representing that work to computational biologists outside Anthropic. The Life Sciences team works to accelerate progress in biology with AI, combining frontier models with hands-on computational and experimental research. We want the tools, pipelines, datasets, and benchmarks we build in genomics and structural biology to be useful beyond our own projects, so we plan to release them to the community. Computational biology has a long tradition of open, shared software, and we want to contribute to it well. Every release should be something a researcher can install, run on their own data, and trust: correct on real inputs, validated against reference data and established methods, documented, versioned, and maintained after launch. You'll own that standard. You'll write a large share of the code yourself, decide when something is ready to ship, and stay with it once people start using it. You'll also be an active member of the biology software community: maintaining public repositories, answering issues, speaking at conferences and workshops, and bringing what you hear from researchers back into what we build next. We use Claude and AI coding agents heavily to build software, and we expect you to do the same across design, implementation, testing, and review. Code written by an agent is held to the same standard as code written by hand: you should understand it, test it, and measure its performance before it ships. We're looking for someone with deep software engineering experience who already works this way. The shape of the role is flexible. You might spend most of your time as an individual contributor, or you might lead a small group of engineers and scientists while continuing to contribute directly. Your focus can be genomics, structural biology, or both. Experience in other areas of computational biology is welcome, and we expect the work to range more widely over time. What matters most is a record of biology software that other people have adopted and relied on. This is a chance to shape how AI is put to work in biological research, on problems that matter for human health and scientific understanding. If building software that scientists trust is the work you want to do, we want to hear from you. Key responsibilities Design, build, and maintain biology software in genomics and structural biology (libraries, command-line tools, pipelines, datasets, and benchmarks) for use by researchers and AI agents, inside Anthropic and externally Own the path from research code to public release, including testing, validation against reference data and established tools, benchmarking, documentation, and packaging, and make the call on when something is ready to ship Maintain what we release: triage issues, review outside contributions, and manage breaking changes Represent the team in the biology community through conferences, workshops, tutorials, and direct work with researchers and maintainers, and turn what you learn about their needs into priorities for the team Partner with the team's computational and experimental scientists to turn research code into well-tested, reusable software Lead the technical direction of the projects you own through design review, code review, and mentoring, and, depending on your interests and the team's needs, lead a small team Build with Claude and AI coding agents as your default way of working, hold agent-written code to the same standard as your own, and set the team's practices for reviewing and validating it Minimum qualifications Have built, released, and maintained biology software that researchers outside your own group use, with evidence of adoption you can point to (for example public repositories, package downloads, citations, or use in other groups' pipelines) Have deep working expertise in genomics or structural biology, including the data types, file formats, standard tools, and common failure modes of at least one of these fields Are proficient in Python and comfortable working with large datasets in Linux and cloud or cluster computing environments Practice rigorous testing and release engineering: unit and integration tests, continuous integration, validation against reference data, packaging, and versioning Use AI coding tools as a central part of how you build software, and can show how you verify the correctness and performance of code you did not write by hand Have led a technical project with multiple contributors, setting direction and reviewing others' work while continuing to write code yourself Can explain technical work clearly to both biologists and engineers, in writing (documentation, tutorials) and in person (talks, workshops) Preferred qualifications Depth in both genomics and structural biology A record as the creator or a core maintainer of a widely used open-source tool in computational biology Experience managing or formally leading a team of engineers or scientists A graduate degree in computational biology, bioinformatics, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent experience Proficiency in a systems language such as Rust, C++, or C, and experience with performance work on large biological datasets Experience building software in other areas of computational biology, such as phylogenetics, proteomics, cheminformatics, or high-throughput screen analysis Experience shipping software built largely with AI coding agents, building agentic systems on large language models, or training machine learning models on biological sequence or structure data The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $300,000 — $320,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Role Overview Cohere has a strong AI narrative, the most deployable product, and a CEO who co-authored the foundational paper of modern AI. Following its recent partnership with Aleph Alpha, the company is positioned to become the transatlantic leader in sovereign AI for enterprise and government, and needs a storytelling engine to deliver that story at scale. This role sits within the team that is building that engine. In this cross functional role, you will stand up our PR and Communications function in the German market. You'll partner with the Global Corporate Communications team and EMEA Communications team to create a regional communication plan that fuels our growth among governments and enterprises in the most highly-regulated industries across DACH. You’ll nurture how we talk to customers, partners, and employees, ensuring that the corporate message resonates culturally for the German market and its audiences. This is a rare opportunity to build a comprehensive German PR function at a fast-growing company in the most dynamic space in technology. This is a role for someone who likes to take big swings – and have fun doing it – where no job is too big or too small. Key Responsibilities As the Communications Manager for Germany, you will: - Own and drive Cohere’s German communications strategy, aligning corporate priorities, business objectives, product innovation, executive visibility and technical differentiation to strengthen the company’s reputation in Germany - Translate Cohere’s innovations and customer success stories into compelling, locally relevant narratives for German-speaking audiences - Lead proactive media engagement and newsjacking opportunities in close collaboration with EMEA Communications and EMEA Government Affairs, capitalising on relevant industry and policy developments to amplify Cohere’s voice - Elevate the profile and influence of Cohere’s German leadership and spokespeople by partnering with Executive Communications to develop strategic messaging, thought leadership, media opportunities and executive visibility programmes, including for the German Country Manager. - Strengthen Cohere’s reputation through customer- and partner-led storytelling, working closely with Partner Marketing to showcase German customer outcomes, deepen strategic relationships and amplify the impact of Cohere’s ecosystem in the local market. - Lead and coordinate German crisis and issues communications, partnering with Corporate Communications and relevant local and regional teams to anticipate reputational risks, develop response strategies and ensure clear and timely communications. Qualifications - Have 7-10 years of experience in B2B communications in DACH, or technical content, ideally in AI, enterprise software, or developer‑focused environments - Have a talent for translating complex topics into different languages without losing nuance - Are experienced at managing PR agencies in the German market - Have experience and/or heavy interest in policy and regulatory communications, particularly within the German/EU regulatory environment - Have experience running communications strategies for the DACH region - Are highly organized and detail‑oriented with strong project management skills and a bias for action - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and thrive in fast‑moving, high‑growth environments - Build strong cross‑functional relationships to drive clarity, consistency, and alignment across teams FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. Within User Safety & Risk Operations, we connect customer onboarding, eligibility review, access provisioning, and support into a service customers can navigate with confidence. We work with Product, Engineering, technical support, regional operations, and customer-facing teams to resolve difficult access problems and improve the systems behind them. Our work combines sound judgment on individual cases with better products, clearer guidance, and automation that reduces unnecessary friction. About the role We’re looking for a senior operations leader to own the Trusted Access operating strategy and lead a team of risk-operations specialists. You will set priorities across programs, build a reliable customer access service, and hire, manage, and develop your direct reports. This role combines program ownership with formal people management. You will establish shared commitments with technical support and regional escalation leaders, who manage their own teams, and bring those groups together around customer outcomes. You’ll stay close enough to complex cases to challenge assumptions while giving specialists the ownership and capacity to fix recurring problems. Success means customers reach the right access outcome with clear communication, teams make consistent decisions, and the service scales with less avoidable escalation and manual work. In this role, you will: - Own the operating strategy and roadmap across Trusted Access programs, translating customer needs and organizational priorities into clear service commitments, ownership, and investment decisions. - Build a coherent customer journey from application and eligibility review through approval, provisioning coordination, and confirmed access, including appeals and subsequent access changes. Establish clear handoffs and route exceptions to authorized decision-makers. - Hire, coach, and develop your team. Set expectations, delegate meaningful ownership, give direct feedback, address performance gaps, and build the capabilities needed as programs grow. - Make capacity and prioritization decisions across urgent customer needs, launch readiness, and lasting improvements. Coordinate regional coverage, vendor support, and backup with partner teams while protecting time to eliminate recurring work. - Lead consequential customer escalations, bringing incomplete or conflicting evidence into a clear decision process. Align owners on the next action and ensure customers receive accurate updates and a clear resolution. - Turn support patterns into a prioritized roadmap with Product and Engineering: improve onboarding, provisioning workflows, tooling, self-service, and AI-assisted operations. Validate that changes work before expanding them. - Establish measures of service health and decision quality. Distinguish fast responses from actual resolution, investigate persistent delays, and use evidence to change priorities. - Prepare new programs and customer channels for launch and scale. Align support responsibilities, review standards, customer guidance, and technical dependencies; make readiness gaps and tradeoffs clear to leadership. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have built and run complex customer support, onboarding, access, risk, or service operations, with measurable improvements beyond handling more volume. - Have formally managed people through hiring, development, difficult feedback, and performance decisions, and can show how your leadership increased the team’s capability and ownership. 5+ years of management experience preferred. - Can make defensible tradeoffs among customer commitments, safeguards, service quality, and capacity, even when stakeholders disagree or the evidence is incomplete. - Have led work across teams you do not manage, resolving ownership gaps and negotiating commitments that hold up in execution. - Are analytically and technically fluent enough to diagnose workflow failures, evaluate automation, and partner effectively on product and provisioning changes. - Communicate with precision and empathy, from explaining an access blocker to a customer to presenting a difficult investment decision to leadership. items.title: Incubation Management Lead
items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE Polymarket ships fast. New products, new market types, new payment rails, new geographies: the pace is real and it does not slow down for anyone. The Customer Experience team's job is to make sure that speed does not come at the cost of the people using the platform. Right now, CX readiness for new launches is a gap we need to close, and this role closes it. You will own launch readiness for CX end to end. That means getting into product planning early, building the readiness plan, standing up a small pilot support pod, and running it until the launch is stable enough to hand off to our scaled operation or external partners. You will write the playbook as you go, because in many cases nobody has supported this type of product before. The team you will work with spans support operations, enablement, and external partners, and you will be the connective tissue between all of them and the Product teams shipping new things. This is a builder role. If you need a defined process to work within, this is not the right fit. If you are energized by figuring out how to support something that has never been supported before, and then making sure the next person does not have to figure it out from scratch, this is exactly the right fit. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build and own the CX readiness plan for every new product, market type, and geography launch, from kickoff through stable handoff. - Embed with Product teams at the planning stage to surface support needs, flag risks, and make sure CX requirements are scoped in before engineering is done. - Stand up and directly manage pilot support pods for new launches, including staffing, tooling, and day-to-day operations during the incubation period. - Work with the Enablement team to produce training materials, SOPs, and QA criteria before each launch goes live. - Track contact rates, issue trends, and customer satisfaction data for newly launched products and report findings back to Product with clear recommendations. - Define the criteria for what "stable" looks like for each launch, and execute the handoff to scaled operations or external partners once those criteria are met. - Build the readiness framework for international expansion, accounting for language, regulatory context, and partner capability as Polymarket enters new markets. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 4 or more years in support operations, program management, or product operations, with direct ownership of launch readiness or go-live planning. - Demonstrated experience launching new products, market types, or geographies from the support side, including building SOPs and training from scratch. - Track record of strong cross-functional partnership with Product and Engineering teams, not just coordination but actual influence on how products are built and scoped. - Comfort operating in ambiguity: you have built processes where none existed and made good decisions without complete information. - Strong written communication, you can write a clear readiness plan, a crisp status update, and a useful post-launch report without someone editing it for you. - Organized and reliable follow-through: teams and partners depend on you to track details and close loops without being chased. - (Plus) Experience at a startup or high-growth company where the roadmap changed fast and you had to adapt your plans to match. - (Plus) Experience managing international or multi-geography launches, including working with external support partners across different time zones and languages. BENEFITS - Competitive salary & equity - Unlimited PTO - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage - 401k match - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories PAY TRANSPARENCY Base salary range: $200,000 to $250,000, plus equity and benefits. This is a good-faith range for the level we're hiring at. Experience varies widely within a title here, so if your expectations fall outside it, reach out anyway. We're always happy to talk it through.
