items.title: Senior Software Engineer, Observability
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Observability team's mission is to build and own Robinhood's full-stack observability platform — the foundation that keeps every product, service, and customer experience running reliably at scale. We design and operate the systems that give engineers deep visibility into how Robinhood's infrastructure behaves, ensuring that when something goes wrong, the right people know immediately and can act fast. Our work spans metrics, logs, distributed tracing, and alerting pipelines, and we partner closely with the Robinhood Command Center to ensure our observability systems meet or exceed 99.9% uptime. We believe in monitoring our own monitors — the observability infrastructure is a product, not just a tool. As a Senior Software Engineer on the Observability team, you will be the technical lead shaping the roadmap for how Robinhood observes itself at scale. You will own the observability control plane end-to-end, making architectural decisions that directly impact the reliability and operational health of Robinhood's entire product surface. You'll lead a team of six engineers, drive the strategy for cost-efficient telemetry ingestion, build in-house solutions where off-the-shelf tooling falls short, and integrate AI-driven approaches to accelerate progress toward full-stack observability. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role where your technical decisions set the direction for the entire organization! This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you'll do Define and execute the full-stack observability roadmap, establishing a clear technical vision for metrics, logs, traces, and alerting infrastructure across Robinhood's engineering organization. Own and evolve the observability control plane, including telemetry ingestion pipelines, cost management strategies, and the tooling that ensures observability components remain highly available. Lead and collaborate with a team of six engineers to build scalable, self-service observability solutions that enable product and infrastructure teams to move faster with greater confidence. Establish and maintain SLOs for observability systems that meet or exceed Robinhood's 99.9% uptime target, ensuring the observability platform is as reliable as the services it monitors. Partner with the Robinhood Command Center and engineering teams across the organization to align on dependency mapping, incident response workflows, and observability standards. What you bring 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record of owning and delivering large-scale observability or infrastructure platform initiatives. Deep expertise in Kubernetes and public cloud environments (AWS preferred), with the ability to architect and operate distributed systems at scale regardless of specific vendor tooling. Strong coding proficiency in one or more languages (Go, Python, or similar) with experience integrating observability agents, libraries, and instrumentation directly into production codebases. Demonstrated experience owning an observability control plane or telemetry pipeline — including ingestion cost management, cardinality control, and signal routing — in a high-traffic production environment. Experience with the Vector data pipeline (or equivalent high-throughput log/metrics routing tools) and familiarity with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Honeycomb, Humio, or Sentry is a plus. Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. items.title: Customer Success Manager, Public Sector & Defence
items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! WHY THIS ROLE? We're seeking an exceptional Customer Success Manager with deep expertise in the Canadian public sector and defence landscape to lead our most strategic government accounts. This role requires an individual who understands both the transformative potential of frontier AI and the unique requirements of government and defence organizations. You will be the trusted advisor and strategic partner for Canadian federal departments, provincial agencies, Crown corporations, defence organizations, and healthcare systems as they navigate the complex journey of AI adoption. You'll guide organizations through the implementation of frontier AI in secure, highly regulated environments—ensuring solutions deliver a measurable impact while meeting stringent security, privacy, compliance, and ethical requirements. In this role, you'll collaborate with our Strategic Customer team, Applied ML (AML) Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Platform, Product, and Go-to-Market teams, serving as the voice of the customer internally and the face of Cohere externally for our most sensitive and high-impact government engagements. You'll have the unique opportunity to shape how Canada's most important institutions leverage AI to serve the public good. Location: Ottawa (proximity to government customers) Security Clearance: Active Top Secret clearance is mandatory for this role WHAT YOU'LL DO Strategic Customer Partnership: - Own the success, adoption, and growth of Cohere's Canadian public sector and defence customers, ensuring they realize maximum value from our AI solutions - Build deep, trusted relationships with senior government stakeholders, including Deputy Ministers, CIOs, ADMs, digital transformation leads, and departmental executives - Develop comprehensive success plans tailored to each organization's mission, digital strategy, budget cycles, and unique constraints - Serve as the primary point of contact and executive sponsor for your accounts, managing escalations and ensuring customer satisfaction - Define and track success metrics aligned with public sector priorities: citizen satisfaction, service delivery improvements, cost savings, operational efficiency, accessibility outcomes AI Adoption & Implementation Leadership: - Guide customers through the full lifecycle of AI adoption—from use case identification and pilot design through production deployment and scaling - Lead secure AI implementation projects in complex government environments, including air-gapped systems, Protected B/C environments, and on-premises deployments - Navigate the unique challenges of public sector AI adoption: legacy system integration, data sensitivity, lengthy approval processes, and risk-averse organizational cultures - Create and execute change management strategies to drive user adoption and value realization across diverse government workforces - Conduct regular executive business reviews with senior stakeholders, demonstrating ROI, impact, and strategic value - Drive contract renewals and account growth by consistently delivering value and building trusted relationships Compliance & Risk Management: - Ensure all implementations meet Canadian government security protocols, including PBMM standards, security assessments, and authority-to-operate requirements - Navigate privacy and compliance requirements: Privacy Act, PIPEDA, PHIPA, Access to Information Act, Official Languages Act, accessibility standards - Lead or support Algorithmic Impact Assessments and responsible AI governance processes as required by Treasury Board directives - Develop risk mitigation strategies for AI deployments in high-security, mission-critical, and citizen-facing contexts - Coordinate with customer security teams, privacy officers, legal counsel, and compliance functions Customer Advocacy & Product Influence: - Serve as the voice of public sector and defence customers within Cohere, advocating for features and capabilities that address government-specific needs - Provide strategic feedback to Product and Engineering teams on requirements related to security, explainability, accessibility, bilingualism, and ethical AI - Contribute to the development of public sector-specific offerings, implementation playbooks, documentation, and best practices - Share customer insights to inform Cohere's public sector go-to-market strategy and positioning - Represent Cohere at government forums, working groups, roundtables, and industry events Cross-Functional Collaboration: - Partner with Sales to support expansion opportunities, renewals, and new customer acquisition - Coordinate with Solutions Architects and Forward Deployed Engineers on technical implementation and optimization - Work with Legal, Security, and Compliance teams to navigate complex procurement, contracting, and regulatory requirements - Collaborate with Marketing on thought leadership content, case studies, and public sector community building YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF: Required Experience: - 8+ years of experience in customer success, account management, strategic consulting, or technology delivery roles within enterprise or government contexts - At least 3-5 years working directly with the Canadian government, defence, or healthcare organizations in a technology, digital transformation, or consulting capacity - Proven track record of managing complex, strategic accounts with multiple stakeholders, long sales cycles, and multi-year implementation timelines - Experience leading AI/ML, cloud, or enterprise software implementations in secure or highly regulated environments - Deep understanding of how government organizations evaluate, procure, implement, and govern technology solutions - Active Top Secret security clearance (mandatory) Customer Success & Account Management Excellence: - Demonstrated success driving customer adoption, expansion, and retention in complex enterprise or government accounts - Experience developing and executing customer success strategies, QBRs, and executive engagement programs - Track record of identifying and closing expansion opportunities within existing accounts - Ability to manage multiple strategic accounts simultaneously while maintaining high-touch, personalized engagement - Experience navigating organizational politics and building coalitions across siloed government departments Public Sector & Defence Acumen: - Comprehensive knowledge of the Canadian public sector ecosystem: federal departments, provincial ministries, Crown corporations, defence, intelligence, critical infrastructure, and healthcare - Deep familiarity with government digital strategies, service delivery transformation, and citizen-centric design principles - Understanding of public sector budget cycles, Treasury Board processes, government procurement frameworks, and contract vehicles - Knowledge of relevant legislation and frameworks: Privacy Act, PIPEDA, PHIPA, Directive on Automated Decision-Making, Algorithmic Impact Assessments, accessibility requirements - Experience with government cloud strategies and security frameworks: GC Cloud, PBMM, Protected environments, CCCS guidelines - Proven ability to work with classified information and operate effectively in secure, compartmented environments Nice to Have: - Bilingual (English/French) proficiency—a strong asset for working across the federal government - 3+ years specifically managing GenAI, LLM, or conversational AI implementations - Experience with specific Canadian public sector digital transformation initiatives: Canada.ca http://Canada.ca modernization, healthcare AI projects, Canadian Digital Service programs, or provincial digital government initiatives - Direct experience working with Canadian defence, intelligence, public safety, or national security organizations - Professional certifications: CSM, PMP, ITIL, or Canadian government-specific security training - Experience with government collaboration platforms: GCdocs, GCworkspace, Protected collaboration tools - Background in management consulting, systems integration, or digital transformation consulting for public sector clients - Experience with any modern programming language (C++, C#, JavaScript, Python, etc.) WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE UNIQUE This is a rare opportunity to shape how Canada's most important institutions leverage AI to serve the public good. You'll work with organizations responsible for national security, healthcare delivery, social services, and democratic institutions—helping them navigate the profound opportunities and responsibilities that come with deploying frontier AI technology. You'll need to balance competing demands: innovation velocity with government due diligence, technical possibilities with policy constraints, commercial success with public sector values, and breakthrough capabilities with ethical considerations. It requires patience, strategic thinking, in-depth sector knowledge, security awareness, and a genuine passion for achieving public service outcomes. If you're energized by complex challenges, have deep public sector expertise, understand the gravity of working with classified systems, and want to have an outsized impact on Canada's digital future while working with cutting-edge AI technology, this role is for you. That covers the team, the martech stack, how we measure marketing's contribution to pipeline, and the budget and pipeline numbers marketing plans against. When leadership asks what marketing produced last quarter and what to fund next, the answer starts with your numbers. The role reports to the VP of Brand. You'll work most closely with the Marketing Chief of Staff and the heads of Growth and Demand and Product Marketing, and every week with Revenue Operations, Sales Operations & Finance. Web operations is part of marketing but doesn't report to this role. WHAT YOU'LL OWN THE TEAM You'll manage the marketing operations, automation, and analytics and data operations staff, and hire where you find gaps. Marketing is growing rapidly, so you'll also bring acquired companies' systems and data into our stack. MEASUREMENT The attribution methodology is yours, documented and signed off by Marketing, Revenue Operations and Finance. Each quarter you'll present marketing's pipeline contribution to the executive team and say what you'd change. Your analysts do the same for the program teams in Growth and Demand, Events and Product Marketing, showing which campaigns and channels are paying back their spend. SYSTEMS AND DATA Marketo, Looker, GA4 and 6sense are yours end to end, along with the campaign and lead side of Salesforce. That includes forms, nurture, lead lifecycle, scoring and routing. Campaign data needs to be structured well enough that analysts don't need workarounds, and target-account data has to reconcile to the governed account list. With Revenue Operations, you'll make sure the data behind marketing's pipeline numbers can't change without a record, so a bulk edit can't quietly rewrite marketing's results. A/B testing on nurture and forms sits with you too, sized so the results can be read. Over time we want fewer tools and fewer dashboards, with one governed source for each metric. BUDGET AND PLANNING NUMBERS You'll own the martech and operations budget and track budget and headcount across marketing. You'll also build the pipeline and capacity models marketing plans against. The Marketing Chief of Staff runs planning and the business reviews and leads the trade-off conversations with your numbers in hand. Marketing and Sales need to count pipeline the same way, every time. By then we should also have an inventory of every reporting surface, each with a named owner, and your order for fixing the data problems you inherit. By three months, one governed executive dashboard has replaced the competing decks in business reviews, and rebuilt lead routing is in production. By six months, target-account reporting reconciles to the governed list, and anyone on the team can reproduce quarterly attribution from the documented method, with change control on the data underneath it. items.title: Director, Order-to-Cash Assurance
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic's global order-to-cash (O2C) function is scaling faster than the processes and systems behind it, across direct enterprise contracts, consumption-based commercial models, and third-party cloud marketplaces. We're looking for a Director, Order-to-Cash Assurance to make sure every order is priced, billed, collected, and recorded correctly, and that we can prove it. You'll be embedded in the O2C Transformation team, working closely with Order Management, AR & Collections, Revenue Accounting, Billing Engineering, and Go-to-Market. You'll design and run the pricing audits and accuracy measures that show us where we leak revenue or create rework, then fix the root cause at the source. You'll be the compliance advocate for global O2C, helping the business find the compliant way to yes, and often improving a process by removing steps rather than adding them. You'll thrive here if you treat accuracy and compliance as design problems and as a service to the business. You are firm when the risk is real, flexible when it isn't, and able to explain the difference. If you're energized by ambiguous, high-consequence operational problems at a company at the forefront of AI development, we'd like to hear from you. Key responsibilities Design and run recurring audit programs across the O2C lifecycle, including pricing audits, contract-to-invoice accuracy, credits, refunds and concessions, and cash application Define accuracy metrics with baselines and targets, such as pricing and invoice error rates, first-pass yield, rework volume, and revenue leakage, and report them in a way teams can act on Trace findings to root cause and work with the owning team on the fix, whether in process, system configuration, or contract and pricing standards Move measurement from periodic sampling to continuous, system-driven monitoring as volume grows Partner with Order Management and AR operations as their quality partner, and help GTM, Deal Desk, Sales Operations, and Product understand what accurate and compliant looks like through clear published guidance that shortens the path to yes Review new processes, process changes, commercial models, and exceptions against policy and control requirements, with clear decision rights, service levels, and rationale that stay consistent across regions, entities, and channels Build compliance into new products, channels, commercial models, and regions by joining at intake rather than at the end Own O2C policies, control ownership, and segregation of duties Partner with Internal Audit, external auditors, Revenue Accounting, Tax, and Legal so audit cycles run smoothly, and resolve findings at the root cause Perform independent review activities, including month-end close reviews, so operations teams can focus on execution while independence is preserved Create reusable, pre-approved process patterns and guardrails so teams can move quickly without a bespoke review every time, harmonizing globally and localizing only where statute requires Work with Billing Engineering, GTM Systems, and Business Technology to build controls and accuracy checks into the systems themselves, so quality scales with volume Deploy AI and automation for exception detection, reconciliation, anomaly detection, and evidence collection Minimum qualifications Hands-on experience designing and running audit, quality, or revenue assurance programs within order-to-cash, billing operations, or quote-to-cash Working knowledge of revenue recognition (ASC 606) and experience partnering with internal and external auditors Experience with contracting systems, billing platforms, or ERP systems (for example Salesforce, Stripe, or Workday Financials) Proficiency with SQL or similar tools for analyzing and testing transactional data Experience using automation or AI for monitoring, testing, or reporting Preferred qualifications 10+ years of progressive experience in revenue operations, billing operations, revenue assurance, finance operations, or internal controls within order-to-cash at a public company A track record of simplifying processes, with concrete examples of steps or controls you removed while improving accuracy or strengthening the control environment A degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Engineering, or a related field CPA, CIA, CISA, or CRISC certification, or Lean Six Sigma or PMP certification Experience building or scaling a SOX program, including readiness for public-company reporting requirements Experience with global, multi-entity operations, including statutory invoicing and tax considerations Experience serving both B2C and B2B customers, especially with consumption-based and subscription billing models through to collections Experience working with go-to-market, deal desk, and revenue operations organizations Strong cross-functional influence and clear communication about issues and decisions Understanding of AI industry business models and enterprise customer needs The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $230,000 — $300,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a senior B2B Growth Marketer to build and scale demand generation for ElevenLabs in India. This is a hands-on, in-country role focused on generating enterprise pipeline, growing our brand with technical buyers, and creating programs that become benchmarks for B2B marketing in AI. Your work will shape how Indian businesses discover, evaluate, and adopt ElevenLabs. The goal is to build repeatable marketing engines that make ElevenLabs the top choice for every enterprise. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build integrated B2B marketing campaigns end to end across India's priority industries from strategy and messaging through execution and measurement. - Localize and execute programs across ABM, content, events, webinars, partner/customer marketing, executive branding, product launches, and outbound - choosing the right channel for the problem rather than owning a single function. - Adapt global campaigns and messaging for the Indian market, and feed local insights (buyer behavior, competitive dynamics, regulatory context) back to the global team. - Partner closely with local sales and the global product marketing, growth, and design teams to keep messaging consistent and execute high-impact campaigns. - Own pipeline generation and campaign performance for the market, using data to measure results, run experiments, and continuously improve what works. items.title: Senior Payroll Tax Specialist
items.location_text: Chicago, IL; Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. Our Global Payroll team is at the foundational stage of building a world-class global payroll ecosystem, and it's a great time to join! We partner closely with Corporate Tax, Corporate Engineering, Accounting, Benefits, Legal, and Global Mobility to make sure employees are paid accurately and on time. We build systems and processes that scale across weekly, bi-weekly, and international payroll cycles. We also work hand in hand with external payroll and tax providers, and we expect strong accountability on both sides. Ethics and accuracy sit at the center of how we work. As a Senior Payroll Tax Specialist, you will report to the Sr. Manager, Global Payroll and serve as the internal subject matter expert and primary operational contact for our external providers. You will own payroll tax processing and reporting across US, Canadian, and global entities, keeping us compliant with local, state, federal, and international regulations. You will configure and test withholding tax setups in Workday, reconcile liabilities, and lead quarter-end, year-end, and audit readiness. An early focus will be resolving legacy tax account discrepancies and putting in place the reconciliation foundation we need to scale, so your work will shape how this function runs for years to come! You will also partner with teams across Finance, Engineering, and People to deliver accurate reporting and analysis. This role is based in our Chicago, IL, Menlo Park, CA and New York, NY offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you'll do Own withholding tax configuration in Workday, including setup, mapping, and maintenance of state, local, and international tax tables, and partner with Corporate Engineering to test changes in sandbox before production release. Run payroll tax processing and reporting across weekly, bi-weekly, and international payroll cycles, including multi-state and internationally mobile employees, and support payroll transitions from M&A activity. Verify accuracy after each payroll with parallel reconciliations, and reconcile payroll tax liabilities weekly across US, Canadian, and global entities, along with quarterly returns filed by third-party providers. Resolve and permanently close out legacy tax discrepancies and historical imbalances, including GL payroll clearing account variances and unclaimed payroll check (escheatment) requirements. Lead quarter-end and year-end execution, including W-2s, T4s, and global equivalents, plus corrections and amended returns (W-2C, Form 941-X), and prepare for payroll tax audits with the IRS, CRA, HMRC, and state and local authorities. Manage agency notices and new tax account setups, act as the point of contact for third-party providers, and deliver reporting and liability analysis to Finance, Accounting, Corporate Tax, and People Operations. What you bring 8+ years of progressive, hands-on payroll tax experience across US and Canadian payroll, with international experience a plus. Hands-on experience configuring and maintaining payroll tax rules in an enterprise ERP (Workday Payroll preferred) and working with third-party tax filing providers such as ADP SmartCompliance. Solid understanding of payroll tax reconciliation, including liability reconciliation, quarter-end and year-end filings, and corrections and amendments. Advanced Excel skills for data analysis and reconciliations, plus comfort using AI tools to streamline reconciliations and filings. An analytical approach to untangling ambiguous tax scenarios with limited guidance. Experience holding vendors accountable and collaborating across Engineering, Finance, and Tax teams. Bonus: Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) and a bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Taxation, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. Base Pay Range: Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC) $100,000 — $118,000 USD Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL) $88,000 — $104,000 USD Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL) $78,000 — $92,000 USD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

This is a fixed term contract covering maternity leave, until August 2027 with the possibility of extension. It’s a role with real creative ownership, where you’ll use LV Group-approved AI tools alongside your craft to scale production and raise the bar for design across the Group. YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: - Utilising data & insight, high-quality design assets for complex projects and campaigns, working independently from brief to final artwork - Ensuring creative output meets the brief, brand standards and agreed deadlines - Localising and adapting designs for local markets and brands so they stay on-brand, compliant and timely - Collaborating with Content, Motion and local market teams to deliver best-in-class campaigns - Providing technical guidance to Graphic Designers on technique, brand standards and best practice - Using LV Group-approved tools (inclusive of AI) to speed up and enhance design production - Keeping up to date with the sector, competitor brand positioning and creative trends to inform design decisions OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING: ESSENTIAL SKILLS - Foster a positive team environment, understanding team dynamics, and cultivating strong relationships with stakeholders. - Demonstrate proficiency in graphic design tools (Adobe Suite, Bannerflow, After Effects, 3D software) with a deep understanding of brands, markets, and specialisations.s - A strong portfolio showing larger or complex design projects and campaigns delivered independently with minimal supervision - Sound knowledge of the iGaming sector, competitor brand positioning and creative trends - Knowledge of local market advertising regulations and how they apply to creative work - Experience supporting or guiding less experienced designers NICE TO HAVES - A data-driven approach to creative decisions and experience - Experience adapting creative across multiple brands, markets or languages WHO WE ARE At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. JOIN US! In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen! items.title: Applied Science - Time Series
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. ABOUT THE JOB Mistral AI is seeking Applied Scientists and Research Engineers focused on time series. You will design, train, and deploy state-of-the-art time-series foundation models, and apply them to the most demanding forecasting problems in industry, from power grids and plants to trading desks. Timestral, our family of time-series foundation models, ranked first on amongst all benchmarks at release (tech report https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.37585v1: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.37585v1 ). The role has two sides: building the next generations of Timestral with our Science team, and taking them into production with our industrial and financial clients, adapted to their data. Working cross-functionally with both external and internal science, engineering, and product teams you will deliver high-impact AI solutions. We are made of researchers, engineers, product builders, ex-founders who love tackling the most complex real world problems in the industry. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Run pre-training, post-training and deploy state of the art time-series foundation models on clusters with thousands of GPUs. - Generate and curate large-scale time-series datasets, real and synthetic, and build evaluators and benchmarks for forecasting and other time-series tasks. - Push the frontier of Timestral: architectures, training recipes, scaling, and new capabilities such as anomaly detection, classification and embeddings. - Fine-tune and adapt Timestral on client data, in the cloud or on-premise, and benchmark it against the client's existing models. - Develop the necessary tools and frameworks to facilitate data generation, model training, evaluation and deployment. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to tackle complex use cases, including agents that combine Timestral with Mistral LLMs. - Manage research projects and communications with client research teams. ABOUT YOU - Fluent in English with excellent communication skills, at ease explaining complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. - Expert with PyTorch or JAX. - Solid knowledge of modern deep learning and large language models: architectures, pre-training, post-training and evaluation. - Experience pre-training or fine-tuning time-series foundation models or large transformer models at scale. - Strong background in time-series modelling: probabilistic forecasting, multivariate series and covariates, and classical baselines (statistical models, gradient boosting). - Not afraid of contributing to a big codebase; finds their way around independently with little guidance. - Writes clean, readable, high-performance, fault-tolerant Python code. - Doesn't need roadmaps: moves independently and is comfortable with uncertainty. - Low-ego, collaborative and eager to learn. - Track record of success through personal projects, professional projects or academia. NICE TO HAVE - Ex-founder or builder - PhD / Master in a relevant field (Machine Learning, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Physics). Exceptional candidates from other backgrounds welcome. - Research on time-series foundation models: pre-training, scaling, synthetic data or evaluation. - Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning LLMs, building agents and tool use, or models that combine text and time series. - Industry experience in energy, industrial operations, telecom or finance, or experience deploying models for industrial clients. - Experience working on large code bases or large machine learning models at scale. - Contributions to a large open-source or industry codebase. - Publications in top academic journals or conferences. - Enjoys improving existing code: typing, tests, CI pipelines. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE Are you a QA Engineer looking to make an impact in a fast-paced, dynamic environment? Join our Sportsbook Domain and become part of the Sports Platform team at LeoVegas Group, where you’ll help shape and enhance our product capabilities. Your work will contribute to delivering a secure, seamless, and engaging experience for customers across all our brands. In this role, you will support the development of our Sportsbook platform by designing effective tests and defining clear testing scopes aligned with business needs. Working in an Agile environment, you will collaborate closely with skilled Java and TypeScript engineers, along with other QA specialists, to deliver high-quality solutions for a reliable and engaging betting experience. YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - Designing, executing, and maintaining test cases for backend and frontend components - Identifying opportunities for automation across the sports data flow and contributing to their implementation - Supporting the design and maintenance of automated tests (service, API, UI) - Collaborating with developers and QAs to define testing scope and ensure adequate test coverage - Executing manual and automated tests as part of the development lifecycle - Reporting, tracking, and verifying defects, ensuring timely resolution - Contributing to improving test processes, reliability, and overall product quality - Communicating risks and findings clearly to team members and stakeholders OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING ESSENTIAL SKILLS - Experience with backend test automation using Java - Practical experience with automated API testing - Familiarity with REST APIs and basic understanding of microservices architecture - Proficiency with test management tools (e.g. TestRail or similar) - Understanding of Agile/Scrum and modern software development practices NICE TO HAVES - Experience with frontend testing including UI automation using TypeScript(Playwright) - Experience with CI/CD pipelines - Basic knowledge of event-driven systems (e.g. Kafka) - Experience with performance testing - ISTQB certification - Interest in or experience with the iGaming domain WHAT WE VALUE - Proactive mindset - you identify issues and opportunities to improve quality - Collaborative approach - you work closely with developers, PMs, and other QAs - Curiosity about the product - you want to understand the platform domain, not just test it WHO WE ARE At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the iGaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 21 offices worldwide. In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen! Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar! As our company's working language is English, we’d like to see your CV in English, please

items.title: Full-Stack Engineer - ElevenCreative Enterprise
items.location_text: Remote, Europe, Poland, United Kingdom, Netherlands
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We build AI-powered engines that make, localize, launch and learn from creative, using ElevenLabs’ full audio and video stack. Enterprise customers are already working with us. While our product teams focus on self-serve, these roles seed a dedicated enterprise engineering team: the people who make ElevenCreative work for our biggest customers and unblock enterprise deals. You sit between the customer and the product. You’ll talk to enterprise customers, understand their requirements, and decide whether to build a bespoke integration for them or a product improvement for everyone. Making that call well is the job. Requirements - Has worked directly with customers as a forward-deployed engineer, solutions engineer or founding engineer at a B2B startup, including presenting to enterprise clients. - Strong full-stack product engineer, comfortable with integrations, APIs, auth and enterprise plumbing such as SSO, access control and security reviews. - Turns a customer’s ask into the real requirement: builds bespoke when it unblocks a deal, and generalizes when several customers want the same thing. - Ships end-to-end with little direction. There’s no PM to define everything first. Bonus: experience with localization or TMS integrations, brand or marketing tooling, or adtech. Location This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere between the US East Coast and Europe, with the ability to operate in European timezones required and flexibility for customer timezones when deals need it. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Dublin, London, New York and Warsaw #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: B2B Partner Operations Manager (m/f/d)
items.description: Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market. Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns. Team Unser B2B Partnerships Team bei Raisin ist das Bindeglied zwischen unserer Plattform und führenden Banken, Finanzberatern und Fintechs in ganz Europa. Gemeinsam ermöglichen wir es unseren Partnern, attraktive Einlagenprodukte digital an ihre Endkund:innen zu vertreiben. Von der Gewinnung neuer Partner über ein strukturiertes Onboarding bis hin zur langfristigen Betreuung bestehender Partnerschaften – wir arbeiten eng, datengetrieben und auf Augenhöhe mit unseren Partnern zusammen und gestalten so aktiv die Zukunft des europäischen Sparmarkts. Your Responsibilities Für unser wachsendes Team suchen wir Unterstützung im Bereich der Betreuung bestehender B2B-Partnerschaften. Diese Rolle ist ein Hybridrolle die einen starken Fokus auf Prozessskalierung mit Relationship- Management-Elementen vereint Du entlastet das Team durch die Zentralisierung, Dokumentation und Automatisierung von wiederkehrenden Relationship Mgmt. Prozessen, z.B. in den Bereichen Reporting, Outsourcing Controlling, CRM Management, Marketing und Kommunikation, SLAs, (technischer) Support. Du identifizierst proaktiv wiederkehrende operative Engpässe und entwickelst Prozessverbesserungen sowie Systemautomatisierungen, um das gesamte B2B-Team effizienter zu machen. Du kümmerst dich um unserer Einzelmaklerpartnerschaften und wirst speziell dieses Partnerschaftsmodel auf einen skalierbaren Level heben. Bei komplexeren Themen arbeitest Du eng mit internen Teams (z. B. Product, Tech, Finance, Legal) sowie bei Bedarf mit externen Stakeholdern zusammen Je nach Erfahrung übernimmst Du eigene Projekte und unterstützt flexibel weitere Themen innerhalb des B2B Partnerships Teams Your Profile Du bringst operative Erfahrung in stark wachsenden Technologieunternehmen (idealerweise in der Fintech-Branche). Alternativ hast du in der Beratung deine ersten Erfahrungen gemacht. Du hast eine ausgeprägt analytische und proaktive Denkweise – anstatt auf Probleme zu reagieren („firefighting“) stehen eine methodische, strukturierte und datengestützte Umsetzung im Vordergrund. Du hast ein starkes Interesse an Systemautomatisierung (idealerweise erste Erfahrung mit No-Code/AI-Tools oder Prozess-Redesign) Du bist extrem hands-on und löst Probleme pro-aktiv und eigenständig. Dabei weißt du mit internen sowie externen Stakeholdern gut umzugehen. Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch auf sehr gutem Niveau; weitere europäische Sprachen sind willkommen Gelegentliche Reisebereitschaft ist notwendig Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us! At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities. As part of our team, you will benefit from: Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year. Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days. A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%. Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month. Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month. Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs. Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office. You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation. Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

items.title: CE Specialist, Voice | Fixed-Term
items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world’s longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. The Voice team is Client Engagement’s premium support channel for high-value clients, providing voice support through the Kraken apps. We deliver exceptional white-glove service that is fast, clear, and trustworthy, earning loyalty through the Voice “friend experience” and shaping each client’s journey into a 6-Star experience. Join a fast-paced frontline team and shape Kraken client journeys. This is a tremendous growth path for an ambitious specialist with a strong performance record and growth mindset. This is an opportunity for someone who wants to round out generalist customer service skills, elevate communication, and work up close with clients. You’ll assist clients and help grow the next generation of Kraken clients across multiple geographies through new products and services, an exciting, hands-on adventure with meaningful impact. This role offers a fixed-term contract, for the duration of 6 months. THE OPPORTUNITY - Answer inbound Voice calls with friendly, professional service, drive quick, accurate resolutions - Clarify client goals, provide education on Kraken products and services, and guide funding, trading, and other account activities - Test new products and features to develop expertise that resolves issues end-to-end and responsibly position products where they fit - Build client relationships, identify growth opportunities and connect clients with Kraken products that meet their needs. - Achieve goals with your manager, contribute to team discussions and 1:1s, and help improve the client experience through feedback and growth projects. WHAT YOU BRING - 2+ years of experience in a customer service or business support role where you’ve proven to be a pro at delivering a 5-star experience. This can be within retail, hospitality, or a customer service center - You must be willing to work shifts on a 24/7 rotating schedule, including evenings and weekends - Exceptional attention to detail, with strong workflow accuracy and process adherence - Highly organized, with excellent time management across multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment - Fluency in both English and Spanish at native-like level; proficiency in Portuguese is a plus - Quick to grasp new concepts, systems, and process changes, and skilled at explaining complex procedures clearly to clients and internal stakeholders - A foundational understanding of how crypto trading works, with the eagerness to deepen that knowledge as Kraken’s product suite grows. - Comfortable with Zendesk and knowledge bases; able to multitask with poise Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. items.title: Staff+ Software Engineer, Enterprise Connectivity
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role A connected Claude is the difference between a general-purpose chatbot and a real coworker. We're building the connected enterprise on three fronts: zero-touch activation, a thriving connector ecosystem, and an enterprise control plane that lets organizations adopt with confidence. We own the path from discovering a connector to using it every day: default and suggested connectors, one-click setup, connector requests, and the identity and admin pieces that remove setup friction for a whole organization at once. You'll be a technical leader who owns activation end to end, from the moment someone sees a connector to their first successful use of it. You'll also help to shape the foundations that help the connector ecosystem grow, and the governance controls that make it safe at enterprise scale. You'll partner closely with product, design and data science, and carry real ownership over what we ship next. What you'll do Own connector activation end to end: measure the funnel from discovery to first use to habit, find the biggest drop-offs, and fix them Build and run experiments on default connectors, in-product suggestions, connector requests and onboarding flows Make setup close to zero-touch, building on open standards like Cross App Access (XAA) and the MCP authorization spec so one approval can turn a connector on for everyone Improve the connectors people reach for most, like Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, so the first experience works and keeps working Lay platform foundations for the connector ecosystem: reusable building blocks that make every new connector easier to launch, discover and activate Build out the enterprise control plane: admin controls and governance (domain restrictions, labels, permissions) that help security teams say yes faster instead of blocking rollout Partner with product, design, data science and sales to turn usage data and customer feedback into priorities Set technical direction and standards for the team, mentor other engineers, and lead with influence rather than authority Minimum Qualifications Have shipped growth or activation work: onboarding flows, funnels, experimentation, and measuring what actually moves usage Are comfortable with authorization and identity (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SSO), enough to make setup flows simple without cutting corners Have built on large platform APIs (Microsoft Graph, Google Workspace or similar) and can debug failures on both sides of the boundary Have built platform or ecosystem surfaces that other teams or developers rely on, and care about durable, well-designed APIs Understand what enterprise admins and security teams need from policy, permissions and governance at scale Use data and user research to decide what to build, and can explain the tradeoffs to product and design partners Drive cross-team and cross-company alignment to ship, with influence over authority Preferred Qualifications Have 8+ years of software engineering experience, ideally with 2+ years at a Staff or equivalent technical leadership level Contributed to or implemented emerging auth standards (IETF OAuth drafts, MCP authorization) Experience with data governance or information protection (sensitivity labels, DLP) Built admin consoles or policy engines for multi-tenant SaaS Run growth experiments on activation funnels Built AI products or agent tool integrations (MCP) Helped grow a developer or partner ecosystem around a platform The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $405,000 — $485,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.title: Software Engineer, Infranomics
items.location_text: San Francisco, New York City, Seattle
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Infranomics team builds the software and data foundations that help OpenAI understand, plan, and improve the economics of its infrastructure. The team works across engineering and finance to make infrastructure spend visible, allocate capacity effectively, and improve efficiency as our products grow. Our systems support the CPU, network, storage and GPU infrastructure behind products such as ChatGPT, the API, and Codex. We are expanding these foundations to connect resource usage, cost, forecasting, and planning so teams can make better decisions at scale. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Software Engineer to lead the design, implementation, and operation of systems for infrastructure cost and efficiency. You will build the platforms that explain where infrastructure spend goes, identify opportunities to improve utilization, and help teams plan the capacity they need. We ideally want direct experience building and operating software for infrastructure economics, such as usage metering, cost attribution, resource efficiency, budgeting, forecasting, or capacity planning. You should have owned systems that connect compute, storage, or network consumption to cost and help teams make measurable efficiency and investment decisions. You will set technical direction for a growing area while staying close to the code. Working with infrastructure engineers, product teams, finance, and leadership, you will turn ambiguous business and engineering problems into reliable software, shared data, and measurable improvements. This role offers substantial autonomy and the opportunity to shape how OpenAI manages its infrastructure investment. This role is based in San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; or New York City, NY. This is an on-site role. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Define the technical direction and roadmap for infrastructure cost and efficiency systems, and lead projects from problem definition through implementation, adoption, and ongoing operation. - Build billing, usage metering, and cost attribution systems that connect infrastructure spend to resources, workloads, services, and the teams that own them. - Develop data pipelines and shared data models that combine cloud billing, resource inventory, and utilization signals into a dependable view of cost and capacity. - Build tools for budgeting, forecasting, and capacity planning that help teams anticipate demand, allocate resources, and inform procurement decisions. - Identify underutilized resources and other sources of waste, then partner with engineering teams to deliver and measure improvements while preserving performance and reliability. - Create APIs, reporting tools, and automated controls that help teams understand their consumption, manage budgets, and make informed infrastructure tradeoffs. - Provide technical leadership across teams, mentor engineers, and own the correctness, scalability, and production behavior of the systems you build. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have over 7 years of experience designing, building, and operating production software and distributed systems, with technical ownership across multiple teams or a significant infrastructure domain. - Have built systems for infrastructure efficiency, cloud cost attribution, usage metering, budgeting, forecasting, or capacity management, and can connect that work to measurable outcomes. - Remain a hands-on engineer who can move between architecture, implementation, debugging, and operational improvements. - Understand how compute, storage, and networking consumption translate into cost, and can reason about the tradeoffs among utilization, performance, reliability, and growth. - Care deeply about data correctness and can build trustworthy systems from complex billing and operational data. - Work effectively across engineering, finance, product, and leadership, translating broad goals into a clear plan and driving adoption without relying on formal authority. - Thrive with substantial autonomy, take ownership of loosely defined problems, and make pragmatic decisions as requirements evolve. - Have experience building internal platforms that give engineering teams visibility into cloud spend, resource utilization, and ownership. - Have experience developing batch or streaming data pipelines, financial data platforms, or large-scale analytics systems. - Have experience with Kubernetes, public cloud infrastructure, or resource management systems across cloud and on-premises environments. - Have experience automating resource allocation, cost allocation policies, budget tracking, or capacity forecasting. items.title: Software Engineer, Traffic Infrastructure
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Cloud Infrastructure team builds and operates the infrastructure behind OpenAI’s products, including ChatGPT and the API. Within Cloud Infrastructure, the Traffic team owns how traffic enters our cloud environments, moves between services, clusters, and regions, and reaches external dependencies. Our work spans cloud networking, Kubernetes networking, ingress and egress gateways, proxies, load balancing, and traffic steering. We build the systems, controls, and observability that make these paths reliable, secure, efficient, and straightforward for other engineering teams to use. ABOUT THE ROLE You’ll build and operate the networking and traffic infrastructure that connects OpenAI’s products and services across clouds and regions. The team’s work spans L3, L4, and L7—from IP connectivity, NAT, and transport behavior to service proxies and application request routing. You’ll bring depth in part of this stack and curiosity about how the whole path works. Projects may include building gateways and control planes, improving cross-region connectivity, diagnosing packet loss or connection exhaustion, and making routing changes safer and easier to operate. This role combines software engineering with production ownership. You’ll turn ambiguous networking problems into durable improvements, working closely with service owners, infrastructure teams, Security, and cloud providers. This role is based in San Francisco, CA or Seattle, WA. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Design, build, and operate ingress, egress, and service-to-service connectivity across clusters, regions, and clouds. - Develop proxies, gateways, controllers, and automation for routing, load balancing, failover, and traffic management. - Build and evolve cloud networking infrastructure, including private connectivity, NAT, and network isolation. - Diagnose failures and performance bottlenecks across application, proxy, transport, and cloud networking layers; work with cloud providers when issues extend into their infrastructure. - Build telemetry and diagnostic tools that explain traffic paths, identify failing components, and help engineers take effective action. - Partner with Security to implement and validate traffic-path protections, including secure service communication, access controls, egress restrictions, and DDoS defenses. - Improve latency, throughput, availability, and network efficiency through measurement, testing, and careful production rollouts. - Create clear interfaces and safe defaults for service teams, participate in on-call, and turn operational lessons into changes that prevent recurring failures and reduce manual work. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have 5+ years of experience building production infrastructure or distributed systems, including substantial work on networking or traffic infrastructure. - Have depth in one or more areas such as cloud networking, Kubernetes networking, proxies and gateways, service meshes, load balancing, or global traffic routing. - Understand networking fundamentals and can reason about how IP routing, TCP/UDP, DNS, NAT, TLS, and HTTP/gRPC affect connectivity and performance. - Have hands-on experience building or operating systems such as Envoy, NGINX, Istio, Cilium, or comparable networking infrastructure. - Write production software in Go, Rust, C++, Python, or a similar language, and use software and automation to solve operational problems. - Can investigate unfamiliar failures using evidence, test hypotheses, and follow problems through to a verified resolution. - Take ownership of design, implementation, rollout, and ongoing reliability, and communicate clearly across teams when a problem crosses ownership boundaries. - Care about making infrastructure secure and understandable for the engineers who depend on it. We value deep expertise and the willingness to learn across boundaries. You do not need prior experience with every technology or networking layer listed above.
